item.summary: Medline Industries, LP is issuing a recall for specific Medline convenience kits containing BD PurPrep 26 mL which may be contaminated with low levels of Bacillus species. Product details: Medline medical convenience kits labeled as: 1) SHOULDER PACK, Medline Kit SKU DYNJ39590O; 2) SHOULDER PACK, Medline Kit SKU DYNJ88566; 3) MAJOR ORTHO KIT, Medline Kit SKU DYNJ911535.
item.affectedPeople: US: CT, FL, KS, OH, OR, NY, MD, MT, VA, MA.
